title: 第9章 修为第10章 合作
content_zh:
洛红颜的回答让长卿再次失望，看来她并非是地球人。
等等，这并不重要，重要的是既然柳露身边已经有了一个认识汉字的人，她为什么还要大费周章的找自己来翻译那本书？
长卿终于发现了关键所在。
显然柳露在对洛红颜隐瞒些什么，如果自己把这个秘密告诉洛红颜的话，对自己是否有利？
不，自己要思考的不应该是这个，问题是那本书写了什么，书中的内容为什么要隐瞒洛红颜。
长卿隐隐有预感，只要搞清楚这个秘密，这一世自己将很有可能逃出生天！
他开始仔细回忆起书中的内容。
“换魂夺舍之法，大致内容就是介绍这个邪术的一些禁忌，必要的条件，和换魂的方式。还有使用这个术法需要用到的御灵以及炼制方法。”
“其中最重要的几个条件分别是，第一，换魂双方必须是元阴或者元阳未破，也就是俗称的处男处女。”
“第二，换魂双方所修炼的功法必须完全一致。”
“第三，必须用特殊炼制出来的移魂灵，才有可能换魂成功。”
柳露虽然不认识书中的文字，但是她肯定知道这本书的大致内容，起码这本书记载的术法是用来做什么的她一定清楚。
联想到一些前世了解到的信息和细节，一个大胆的猜测浮现在长卿的脑海中。
“你先告诉我，你修行的功法是什么？”长卿问道。
洛红颜迟疑了片刻，随口坦诚道。
“我修行的是火属炼法。”
这倒是有些出乎长卿的意料，他听说炼法修士极其稀有，而且地位崇高，没想到洛红颜就是一名炼法修士。
“你可曾把你的功法，传授给了柳露？”
洛红颜略有些惊讶。
“不错，我传授她炼法已有数年了，实际上我应该算是她的师傅，不过碍于身份，我答应她在外人面前都称呼她为师傅。”

她的回答再次印证了长卿的猜测。
“你可是和她做了什么交易。”
“这些都是你猜出来的？”洛红颜的语气终于不再像刚刚那么淡然，“是，我答应传授他炼法，只要她的炼法境界有所突破，她就答应放我离开这里。”
说着，她有些不放心似的，朝柳露打坐的方向看了一眼。
“当然我知道像她这种疯子是不能相信的，所以我教她的功法一直残缺不全，让她的炼法造诣迟迟没有提升，同时我也在寻找离开这里的方法，如果你能告诉我她在丹室都让你看了什么，也许我们可以合作。”
洛红颜的话长卿自然赞同，但他还不能完全相信眼前这个女人，她说的话也有可能是和柳露串通好的，为的就是从自己口中套出那本书真正的内容。
他还需要再验证一番。
“既然你精通炼法，你可知道有什么帮人恢复成元阴或者元阳之身的方法吗？”
“方法是有，但很少有人会使用，耗费时间不说，还对身体有所损伤，甚至损失修为，修为越高，逆练元阴的代价就越大。”
洛红颜迟疑道。
“你是怀疑这些年柳露在逆练元阴？”
长卿心下了然，前世他就听说宗主柳露已经多年没有和人种交合采补过了，而且传闻柳露以前在修炼时受了伤，留下了暗疾，这些年修为倒退了不少。
“看来这老蛇果然是想把自己逆练回元阴之身。”
长卿心中冷笑。
这世上的修士只能同时修行一种功法，若是要修行其他功法，那就必须舍弃原本的功法，从头开始。
content_en:
Luo Hongyan's answer disappointed Changqing again. It seemed that she was not from Earth.
Wait, this is not important. What is important is that since Liu Lu already has someone around her who knows Chinese characters, why did she go to such trouble to find herself to translate the book?
Changqing finally discovered the key.
Obviously Liu Lu was hiding something from Luo Hongyan. Would it be beneficial to herself if she told Luo Hongyan this secret?
No, that shouldn't be what I have to think about. The question is what was written in that book and why was the content in the book hidden from Luo Hongyan.
Chang Qing had a vague hunch that as long as he figured out this secret, he would be very likely to escape in this life!
He began to carefully recall the contents of the book.
"The method of exchanging souls and seizing bodies, the general content is to introduce some taboos, necessary conditions, and methods of exchanging souls of this evil spell. There are also the soul control and refining methods needed to use this spell."
"The most important conditions are: first, the soul-swapping parties must have unbroken Yuan Yin or Yuan Yang, which is commonly known as a virgin."
"Second, the techniques practiced by both parties in the soul exchange must be exactly the same."
"Third, you must use a specially refined soul-transferring spirit to be able to successfully change your soul."
Although Liu Lu didn't know the words in the book, she definitely knew the general content of the book. At least she must know what the spells recorded in the book were used for.
Reminiscent of some information and details learned in previous lives, a bold guess emerged in Chang Qing's mind.
"Tell me first, what are the techniques you practice?" Chang Qing asked.
Luo Hongyan hesitated for a moment and said frankly.
"I practice fire-based refining."
This was somewhat beyond Chang Qing's expectation. He had heard that law-refining monks were extremely rare and had a high status. He did not expect that Luo Hongyan was a law-refining monk.
"Have you ever taught your skills to Liu Lu?"
Luo Hongyan was a little surprised.
"Yes, I have been teaching her how to practice for several years. In fact, I should be considered her master. However, due to my status, I promised her to call her master in front of outsiders."
Her answer once again confirmed Chang Qing's guess.
"What kind of deal did you make with her?"
"Did you guess all this?" Luo Hongyan's tone was finally no longer as indifferent as before, "Yes, I promised to teach him how to practice. As long as she makes a breakthrough in the realm of how to practice, she promised to let me leave here."
As she said that, she looked a little worried and glanced in the direction where Liu Lu was meditating.
"Of course I know that crazy people like her can't be trusted, so the exercises I taught her have been incomplete, which has prevented her from improving her skills. At the same time, I am also looking for a way to leave here. If you can tell me what she showed you in the alchemy room, maybe we can cooperate."
Changqing naturally agreed with Luo Hongyan's words, but he still couldn't completely believe the woman in front of him. What she said might have been colluded with Liu Lu in order to get the true content of the book out of him.
He still needs to verify it again.
"Since you are proficient in refining, do you know of any methods to help people restore their Yuanyin or Yuanyang bodies?"
"There is a method, but few people use it. Not only is it time consuming, but it also causes damage to the body and even causes a loss of cultivation. The higher the cultivation, the greater the cost of practicing Yuan Yin reversely."
Luo Hongyan hesitated.
"Do you suspect that Liu Lu has been practicing Yuan Yin in reverse these years?"
Chang Qing was heartbroken. In his previous life, he had heard that the sect leader Liu Lu had not had sex with a human race for many years and had not taken supplements. It was also rumored that Liu Lu had been injured while practicing and had hidden diseases. Her cultivation had declined a lot over the years.
"It seems that this old snake really wants to train himself back to the Yuan Yin body."
Changqing sneered in his heart.
Monks in this world can only practice one skill at the same time. If they want to practice other skills, they mustThe original technique must be discarded and start from scratch.
